records.observation: Blue slats are the sole visible seating surface over two substantial gray box supports, forming a recognizable backless bench. Sections reveal gaps between the seating level and box tops and a few small underside remnants. C still has a plausible seat role and both supports remain; this visual judgment does not certify an actual geometric connection.

Blue slats are the sole visible seating surface over two substantial gray box supports, forming a recognizable backless bench. Sections reveal gaps between the seating level and box tops and a few small underside remnants. C still has a plausible seat role and both supports remain; this visual judgment does not certify an actual geometric connection.

Coherent L-shaped corner bench wraps the blue L-shaped seat with gray back panels and visible slim legs. Both obliques place C in the seating region rather than under a competing gray seat; fixed sections are compatible with a backing/support frame. Section breaks alone do not establish detached fragments; no clear redundant seat layer or folded sheet.

Coherent L-shaped corner bench wraps the blue L-shaped seat with gray back panels and visible slim legs. Both obliques place C in the seating region rather than under a competing gray seat; fixed sections are compatible with a backing/support frame. Section breaks alone do not establish detached fragments; no clear redundant seat layer or folded sheet.

Blue slats remain the intended seating surface, but the gray completion is reduced to extremely thin hanging leg traces and small underside remnants. Across both obliques no substantial supporting panels or coherent supporting frame can be resolved. Main support/body is impaired; this is more than section endpoints alone. No definite folded layer is visible.

Blue slats remain the intended seating surface, but the gray completion is reduced to extremely thin hanging leg traces and small underside remnants. Across both obliques no substantial supporting panels or coherent supporting frame can be resolved. Main support/body is impaired; this is more than section endpoints alone. No definite folded layer is visible.

Blue plate still supplies the upper seat, but the rounded gray end supports have become separated thin ribs/triangular remnants, with lower gray strips floating beneath. Both obliques show interrupted end arcs; the whole loop-supported bench is no longer visibly coherent. Missing support surface and gaps are clear; the intentional lower rail is not itself called a duplicate seat.

Blue plate still supplies the upper seat, but the rounded gray end supports have become separated thin ribs/triangular remnants, with lower gray strips floating beneath. Both obliques show interrupted end arcs; the whole loop-supported bench is no longer visibly coherent. Missing support surface and gaps are clear; the intentional lower rail is not itself called a duplicate seat.

Gray seat remains above and covers blue C. End panels have conspicuous ragged gaps and the lower supports reduce to disconnected strips/partial plates. The two obliques reveal damaged ends, and both sections retain the competing gray seat height. Body/support are impaired, with no adopted blue seating top.

Gray L-shaped corner bench retains its back panels and legs. Blue plate is below the gray L-shaped seating level and projects into the empty center; it remains separated rather than naturally serving as the seat. A visible C/body gap remains, but no clear folded gray sheet is resolved.

Gray slab bench and end-panel supports remain coherent. Blue C sits far below and projects beside its gray seat, as shown by both obliques and sections. There is a clear C/body gap and no plausible seat adoption; no definite folded gray fragment is resolved.

Gray back and end supports remain but seating region consists of separated narrow rails with broad gaps. Blue patch projects from an intermediate level while the gray seat is lower. The completion does not organize a coherent seating surface around C; support structures are still visible.

Blue slatted seat floats above a distorted low gray shell. Gray end panels have separated triangular pieces and uneven lower strips, with no coherent support arrangement around C. Front and side sections show large seating-height mismatch and layered broken surfaces.

Gray slab bench and end supports remain recognizable. Broad gray triangular faces cover most blue slats, forming a separate top slightly above C; diagonal blue strips remain visible through the overlay. No clearly detached debris, but competing seat coverage remains.

Gray plank bench remains on end-panel legs; the upper seat has irregular projecting strips and blue C sits substantially below it. The clear height gap persists in both sections. The body and supports remain recognizable but C is not the seating top; nearby gray layers/strips remain.

Gray L-shaped corner bench retains back panels, a seating rim and legs. Blue plate hangs lower in the central open region, separated from the gray seat level in the oblique views and sections. No clear folded sheet is visible, though the C/body gap remains.

Blue slats remain above an almost erased gray seat and support assembly. Obliques show only thin detached leg/crossbar traces at a lower level; sections resolve little gray surface. Body and principal supports are impaired. With the competing gray seat largely gone, whether the residual completion meaningfully adopts C is uncertain; no clear folded gray layer remains.
双视角中箱形端支撑与背板存在，但灰色座面条带断续且低于蓝C；蓝C横跨背侧高处，正侧截面显示两套座高，未形成合理采用。
灰色有背长凳及端支撑可辨；蓝C浮在灰座与背板中部而未作为该凳座面，侧截面明确分层。局部细小游离条片可见，未据双层截线单独认定折叠。
灰色双柱支撑长凳整体可辨，顶面由多条厚灰板组成；蓝C贯穿厚板中层而非作为外露座面，侧截面可见灰板同时位于蓝面上下。未见明确孤立碎片；重叠覆盖清楚。
灰色条板座与双柱支撑完整可辨，蓝C仅在条缝中露出，侧截面仍穿过灰色厚板内部。条件没有被当作最终座表面，灰板覆盖/重层明确；没有从图中确认独立漂片。
蓝C是唯一完整的上部座板，作为该物体座面仍可解释；灰色箱形侧壁、底部支撑和斜片却严重断裂，底面有大孔与交错残片。侧截面有明显间隙；这里的用途PLAUSIBLE不表示已经接上或成品完整。
双柱支撑和灰色条板凳整体完整可辨，但蓝C仍埋在厚灰板中部，侧截面重复覆盖清楚，未作为最后暴露的座表面。未见明确孤立碎片。
灰色高腿靠背凳及窄座板自身完整可辨；蓝C比灰座宽长，悬在其上方并穿过背框所在平面。正侧截面显示独立灰座与上方蓝面间的空隙，C没有替代已生成的完整座面；未确认折片。
双视角仍是带完整灰座板的高腿靠背凳，蓝C悬盖且向两侧越出灰座；正侧截面保持独立的蓝/灰座高。主体和主要支撑存在，条件采用失败，未从图上确认折叠。
灰色有背长凳的端支撑和下方座条仍可辨；蓝C悬在灰座之上、位于背板中段。侧截面明确分离，未把C用作实际座面。背侧有细碎条带，但不据此认证非法相交。
主体灰背板、座条与端架合理可辨，蓝C却仍浮于灰座上方的背板中部，双视角及侧截面一致。存在局部细条残片/间隙，未确认额外折片。
灰色高腿靠背凳形体与支撑保持，灰色座板仍单独位于蓝色条板下方，且背框穿过蓝片范围。两个截面均有错层/间隙；蓝C未成为该完整灰座的替代，未确认额外折片。
蓝色条板下的灰座与支撑仅剩极细杆线和断续残点，主体表面严重缺失。因完成体损失太大，C是否被合理采用保留不确定；不能把没有竞争灰座自动当采用成功。
灰色高腿凳形体、背框和完整窄座板仍在，蓝色较宽条板悬在其上方并横穿背框高度。正侧截面保留明显独立座高；C未融入替代灰座，未确认折叠。

两个斜视角都显示蓝色条板悬于几乎被削空的灰色支架，截面灰表面近乎只剩短点线。明显主体/支撑缺损和间隙；C关系不确定，未从残存片段确认折叠。
